items.content: Are contradictory demands placed on you at work?
Do you sometimes have to do things which ought to have been done in a different way?

scores.label: Role Conflicts
scores.description: 互相矛盾的要求或难以按合适办法完成工作的情形更多

interpretations.headline: When expectations pull in different directions
interpretations.summary: A task may come with demands for faster delivery and more checks. This result describes how often expectations clash or the required way of doing things feels unsuitable.

guidance.text: Write down two expectations that are in tension and ask the decision-maker which comes first. Name the trade-off so the team can act on the same information.

limitations: 本维度由 2 个附录原项构成。各题按 0、25、50、75 或 100 计分，同权求均分。系统仅在答全时计算，未完成的答卷没有该分数。
互相矛盾的要求或难以按合适办法完成工作的情形更多。结果描述本次作答。可用证据限于该维度相关国际中版研究，项目不套用地方常模、风险分级和个人能力评级。

English items and the five response options come unchanged from Annex 1. This descriptive score is the mean of completed items when all items are answered. Higher scores indicate more of the characteristic named by the scale. Formal risk assessment and clinical interpretation require separate information.
report.disclaimer: 用于成年工作人群的非商业研究和自我回顾。请结合具体情境理解。 For non-commercial research with adult workers and personal reflection.
